## 📌 Pull Request Overview

### Description
Please provide a brief summary of what this pull request changes or implements.

### Related Issue
Closes #[issue-number] (or fixes/addresses)

---

## 🛠 Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update
- [ ] 🎨 Style / Refactor (formatting, UI tweaks, clean up)
- [ ] ⚡ Performance optimization

---

## ✅ Quality Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have checked that frontend builds without errors (`npm run build:client`)
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation / README where applicable
- [ ] No sensitive credentials, secrets, or API keys are committed
